items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: And bass on that's where Patrick stands.

ctx.x: You were saying that when Brother played the blues, first one or two came around and then... Everybody started. And they were just watching him...

That was the place, the first place I took a drink in my life. They were just watching him play. That's right. They enjoyed it so much. They enjoyed him and he was playing. I mean, he could... In other words, he could stop a dance when he got ready. Yeah. Yeah. And he left us and we picked up a woman by the name of Vivian from Atkins, Kansas. And she was very good paying up there too. She came up with a band that we came down there. And you know, until the band... Things like a little tough and bad. But she was a…
